measures.title: Non-binding advisory question concerning voting qualifications
measures.summary: Asks whether Illinois law should be changed to require voters to provide a valid photo identification once, either when registering to vote or before voting for the first time, while ensuring all eligible citizens can get that identification free of charge. The question is advisory only and does not change any law.
measures.yesMeans: You support the change described in this advisory question.
measures.noMeans: You do not support the change described in this advisory question.

measures.title: Non-binding advisory question concerning the redistricting process for state legislative maps
measures.summary: Asks whether state legislative districts should be compact, contiguous and equal in population, and drawn by a non-partisan commission instead of elected officials, without considering party registration and voting history data. The question is advisory only and does not change any law.
measures.yesMeans: You support the change described in this advisory question.
measures.noMeans: You do not support the change described in this advisory question.

measures.title: Non-binding advisory question concerning property tax relief
measures.summary: Asks whether the Illinois General Assembly should pass legislation to cap and lower local property taxes and provide state funding to local governments that agree to reduce property tax levies. The question is advisory only and does not change any law.
measures.yesMeans: You support the change described in this advisory question.
measures.noMeans: You do not support the change described in this advisory question.
